qs.q:
Match each message (1–5) and its meaning (A–F).
There is one letter that you do not need.

0. When you come to London, there's no need for you to book into a hotel. You can sleep at my place. [G = Stay with me.]
1. About this evening. I've got a lot of work to do, so you'll just have to go without me. Enjoy.
2. I'm so sorry to hear you're leaving. Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly. You're simply the best.
3. You have to see the Batman movie. It's only on for a few more days, and you'll be sorry if you don't see it.
4. I know it hurts that you broke up with Dan, but you shouldn't feel bad about it. I'm sure it was for the best.
5. Hi. Here's the essay I promised you. It's not perfect, I know, but I tried really hard and I couldn't write anything better.
items: 1 — I've got a lot of work to do, you'll have to go without me.
2 — Can't you possibly stay? I'll miss you terribly.
3 — You have to see the Batman movie, it's only on a few more days.
4 — You shouldn't feel bad about breaking up with Dan.
5 — Here's the essay. It's not perfect but it's the best I could do.
rights: B — It's the best I could do.
